methodologyNotes: Roster covers 12 current-market monitor arms spanning single and dual configurations, gas-spring and mechanical mechanisms, across budget ($35-$70), mid-range ($175-$200), and premium ($305-$360) tiers. Primary sources were manufacturer product pages (vivo-us.com, walielectric.com, huanuo.com, mount-it.com, store.hermanmiller.com) and authorized resellers (ergodirect.com, staples.com); prices reflect published US MSRP or list price as of the access date. Two products (North Bayou F80, Loctek D5D) have priceUsd=null because no current, authoritative in-stock US published price could be confirmed (a null beats a guess). Specs use US customary units (inches, pounds); full_motion is true when the arm offers independent tilt, swivel, and rotation; mechanism distinguishes gas_spring (pneumatic counterbalance) from mechanical (friction/spring-tension/thumbwheel without sealed gas). accessedAt 2026-06-20.
